common.errorGeneric: Please try again. Still stuck? Ask for help at the pick-up location.

auth.welcomeBody: Sign up, fill in your details once, and on Friday just show your QR code.
auth.startClient: I am here to collect a food parcel

register.doneTitle: Thank you, your application has been sent

errors.household: A household has at least 1 person

profile.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are switched off in your phone settings.
